Privacy Policy — What We Collect

Last updated 27 October 2026

This describes what we collect, why, and what we do not do with it. It covers the website only.

Who we are

TODO — not yet decided. Registered legal entity name and type (sole proprietorship, partnership, private limited), and the registered address if it differs from the address below.

Sarvha sells essential oils online in India from B-13, Rana Pratap Bagh, Nr. GT Road Industrial Area, New Delhi – 110007, India. For anything in this policy, write to hello@sarvha.com.

What we collect

Only what an order or an enquiry actually needs.

If you create an account

  • Your name and email address.
  • Your mobile number, if you give one.
  • A scrambled form of your password. We never store the password itself, and cannot read it or recover it for you.

If you place an order

  • Your delivery address and phone number.
  • What you bought, what it cost, and when.
  • Any delivery note you add at checkout.

If you write to us or subscribe

  • Your name, email address and your message.
  • Your email address alone, if you join the newsletter.

We do not collect your date of birth, your gender, your location, or anything else we have no use for. There is no advertising or analytics tracking on this site at all — no Google Analytics, no advertising pixels, no third-party scripts watching what you look at.

Card details

We never see them. Payments are handled by Razorpay, which collects your card or UPI details directly on their own systems. Nothing about your payment instrument reaches our servers or our database — we are told only whether a payment succeeded and for how much.

Razorpay handles that data under their own privacy policy, which applies to the payment step.

Cookies and what your browser stores

One cookie, and only once you log in. It holds a random token that tells us you are signed in. It cannot be read by scripts, it is only sent over an encrypted connection, and it expires after 30 days.

Your browser also keeps your shopping cart, and your first name if you are logged in, in its own local storage. Both stay on your device and are never sent to us. Clearing your browser data removes them.

There are no advertising or tracking cookies on this site.

Who else sees your data

As few people as possible, and only to get your order to you.

  • Razorpay, to take the payment.
  • The courier, to deliver the parcel — they get your name, address and phone number.

TODO — not yet decided. Name the courier or couriers you use, and name your hosting and database providers and the country their servers are in. A privacy policy has to say who processes the data and where.

We do not sell your data, rent it, or share it with anyone for marketing. Nobody gets your details to advertise to you.

TODO — not yet decided. How long order records are retained. Tax rules set a floor on this, so check what your accountant requires before stating a period.

Newsletter subscriptions are kept until you unsubscribe. Messages you send us are kept so we have the history if you write again.

What you can ask us to do

  • Tell you what we hold about you.
  • Correct anything that is wrong.
  • Delete your account and your personal details.
  • Stop emailing you.

Email hello@sarvha.com and ask. We may have to keep order records we are legally required to retain, and we will say so if that applies.
